info.title: Get Return Records
info.description: Use this API to retrieve the record entries for a specific return request. Each item in data.records represents an action or lifecycle event for the specified return_id.

get.description: Use this API to retrieve the record entries for a specific return request. Each item in data.records represents an action or lifecycle event for the specified return_id.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying the return reason, delimited by commas. Default: en-US
Refer to [Locale codes](678e3a47bae28f030a8c7523) for the list of supported locale codes.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

event.description: The event type that represents which lifecycle event this record describes. It can vary depending on the current status and the return flow of the request, including the initial request, seller actions, shipment events, and timeout or system events.

role.description:
The actor that initiated this lifecycle event. Possible values:
- `BUYER`
- `SELLER`
- `OPERATOR`: The action was triggered manually by a customer service agent.
- `SYSTEM`: The action was triggered automatically due to a policy reason.

reason_text.description: The corresponding text for a return reason, localized based on the locale input parameter.

note.description: A note provided by the seller or buyer. You can use the role field to differentiate whether the note is from the seller or buyer.
note.example: Reach an agreement with the buyer

width.description:
The width of image. 
Unit: px

height.description:
The height of image.
Unit: px

images.description: Images provided by the seller or buyer. You can use the role field to differentiate whether the images are from the seller or buyer.

videos.description: Videos uploaded by the buyer. Only buyers are allowed to upload videos.

create_time.description: The Unix timestamp for when this record entry was created.
